name: Ureshino Meguri
source:
A shrine maiden at the ancient Tanogo Shrine which stands unnoticed in Tokyo. She has an accute sensitivity to the energy flow of people and nature more so than any regular person, she can even have premonitions in her dreams. When she was a high school student, she met the protagonist while they were visiting the shrine and foresaw their strange future. She uses her knowledge in the supernatural to explain phenomenan to the protagonist and Tomona.

[From [url=https://tokyo-psychodemic.com/?lang=en]Official Website[/url]]
